name: 序列甲板
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Redesign the Chinese computer-science learning platform ‘词元研究所’ as a restrained science-fiction mainframe mission console. This is composition option B, ‘sequence deck’.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, deep graphite-black operational surface.
Subject: a real learning dashboard. The wordmark 词元研究所 sits in a compact upper-left system block. The top navigation is a single horizontal command bar with 总览, 学习中心, RAG辅导, 代码练习, 学习画像 plus a visible appearance-control icon. The main canvas is dominated by a wide horizontal learning sequence with four precise stations connected by a baseline: 学情定位, 资料检索, 代码训练, 确定性验证. The current Python station is expanded downward into the primary task module Python 函数 / 继续学习. A compact bottom row contains three equal course modules for C语言, Python, 数据结构 with mastery readouts and next-step labels. A slim right edge carries live session status and study time.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished product UI concept, early mainframe control panel fused with spacecraft flight-sequence planning, modern semantic layout, real controls and readable cards, not a poster.
Composition/framing: top command bar instead of a sidebar, wide sequential central spine as the dominant move, low stacked depth, calm lower telemetry row, one clear focal action.
Color palette: near-black and cool slate neutrals with one selectable ion-cyan accent active; cyan appears only in current step, focus, progress, and primary action. No red frames. White text with high contrast.
Materials/textures: matte instrument panel, fine ruled dividers, calibration ticks and tiny status lamps; no glassmorphism, no glossy 3D.
Typography: Chinese sans-serif content, compact monospaced numerals and uppercase English metadata. No oversized headline.
Constraints: desktop application screen; unmistakably a learning workflow; clear information hierarchy; restrained sci-fi, not cyberpunk; no decorative charts; no gradients; no huge slogan; no floating rounded pill clusters; no purple; no red; no neon glow haze; no robots, spaceships, planets, photographs, or marketing illustration; no watermark.
